versions.changelog:
Initial release of ModelSpy for OpenAI-compatible endpoint identification:

- Enables behavioral analysis to detect the true underlying model behind any OpenAI-compatible endpoint.
- Does not rely on declared model info—uses multi-dimensional evidence (tokenizer, trap questions, generation speed, etc.) for identification.
- Offers ranked candidates with confidence scores and clear verdicts (一致, 不一致, 证据不足).
- Provides single-file CLI binaries for all major platforms; requires only endpoint URL and API key.
- Designed to help users verify claims from proxies, API resellers, or third-party endpoints.
